stem: One row lies in a wind corridor and dries faster than the rest of the field. What is the strongest response?
choices: Map the wind-related microclimate and evaluate localized irrigation/support adjustments rather than changing the whole field uniformly
Assume wind can only reduce disease risk and has no water-demand effect
Move the weather station and ignore plant response
rationale: Wind can increase water demand and mechanical stress locally, so management should reflect the mapped microclimate.
